errors.description: The curved fly extension sits slightly further from the centre-front line than the blueprint draws it. Measured at magnification on candidate-2: centre-front fold at x=442px, fly J edge at x=512px, giving a 70px extension against a 680px waistband width = 10.3%. The blueprint has the centre line at x=607 and the fly edge at x=680 on a 910px waistband = 8.0%. Attempt 2 was generated with an explicit clause asking for 8%; the measured value did not move from attempt 1 (10.7%), so this dimension is not responsive to prompt correction and a third generation was judged unlikely to converge.

notes: Two generations spent of a budget of three; stopped deliberately at two. Attempt 1 (candidate-1.png) was already correct on the showcased craft option but had three belt loops visible against the blueprint's two, was shifted right of frame centre, and rendered the fly J so faintly that it needed contrast enhancement to trace - weak for an option whose whole purpose is to let a customer see that nothing is there. Attempt 2 (candidate-2.png) fixed the belt loop count, centred the garment, and made the fly J clearly legible unaided while keeping the fly completely free of topstitching. No feature that was correct in attempt 1 was lost in attempt 2 - this is the better image and the one to ship. The single remaining deviation is the fly extension width; it was named explicitly in the attempt-2 correction clause and did not move at all, which is evidence the model will not resolve it, so a third generation was not purchased. Verified by direct measurement at magnification: topstitch absence, fly handedness, fly depth, belt loop count, side pockets, orientation. Not independently verified: the exact number of belt loops hidden around the sides and back of the garment, which the blueprint does not show either.
